g.text: Workflow 1 — Candidate Job Application & Resume Snapshot Architecture
Discovery → Eligibility Guard → Resume Ownership Check → Immutable Snapshot → ZeptoMail Dispatch → Recruiter Review & Stage Updates
EXECUTION PIPELINE: 8 SEQUENTIAL PHASES FROM DISCOVERY TO RECRUITER PIPELINE
Orphaned files deleted on submission abort
Network failure never aborts DB save
1. API ROUTE HANDLERS, PAYLOAD SCHEMAS & VALIDATION GUARDS
• Auth Guard: career_session cookie resolved by ServerAuth into candidate user entity
Fields: { coverNote?: string, answers?: Record<string, any>, resumeId?: string, resumeUrl?: string, isNewUpload?: boolean }
• Rejection Handlers: Returns HTTP 400 with structured JSON error details on malformed payload
• Auth Guard: career_recruiter_session cookie resolved by serverAuth
• Tenant Verification: Verifies application's job.companyId === auth.company.id
Cross-company resume access attempt immediately rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden
• Storage Provider: Resolves file via StorageFactory.getProvider() from local disk buffer
• HTTP Headers: Streams with Content-Type: application/pdf & Content-Disposition: inline
• Job-Level Scoping: assertApplicationAccess(auth, id) checks assignedJobIds & interviews
• Permitted Stages: APPLIED → UNDER_REVIEW → SHORTLISTED → INTERVIEW → OFFER / REJECTED
• Audit Emission: Emits RECRUITER_APPLICATION_STATUS_UPDATED event with actor details
• Duplicate Submission Lock: Prisma unique compound index [candidateId, jobId] halts concurrent duplicate calls.
• Withdrawn Re-activation: Withdrawn applications can be re-applied idempotently without creating duplicate IDs.
• Orphan File Cleanup: If candidate uploads a new PDF but application creation fails, disk storage and db.resume are wiped.
• Non-Destructive Existing Resumes: Pre-existing profile resumes are never deleted on application failure.
2. DATA PERSISTENCE & IMMUTABLE RESUME SNAPSHOT SCHEMA
IMMUTABLE RESUME SNAPSHOT FIELDS (Preserves Application State Forever):
resumeId String? @db.ObjectId (Linked resume ID at application time)
resumeFileSize Int? (Exact byte length at submission: 1,245,820)
INDEX CONSTRAINT: @@unique([candidateId, jobId]) — Guarantees atomic candidate submission uniqueness
Why the Immutable Resume Snapshot is an Architectural Core:
If a candidate subsequently modifies, replaces, or deletes resumes in their profile, the recruiter still reviews
the exact resume snapshot originally submitted with the job application.
Hiring decisions and interview scorecards must correspond to verified historical credentials.
Applications maintain permanent forensic integrity through the frozen fields.
Recruiter resume streaming route reads directly from the frozen application snapshot parameters,
completely decoupling recruiter access from candidate profile state mutations.
RESULT: 100% deterministic, immutable candidate submission audit trail in MongoDB.
3. SECURITY GUARDS, RBAC MATRIX & NOTIFICATION DELIVERY
Checks for session cookies before request reaches Node.js runtime, redirecting unauthenticated users.
Queries db.user and db.companyMember, rejecting suspended accounts with HTTP 401.
Recruiter endpoints strictly inject where: { job: { companyId: auth.company.id } } on all DB queries.
Interviewers restricted to assigned candidate interviews; Hiring Managers restricted to assignedJobIds.
VIOLATION ENFORCEMENT: Any cross-company request fails immediately with HTTP 403 Forbidden
Injects candidate name, job title, company logo, application timestamp, and tracking URL.
Informs hiring managers with direct review link to candidate application card.
• Audit Logging: Saves messageId, recipient, and delivery status to db.emailDelivery
• Resilient Execution: Wrapped in try/catch — never throws or rollbacks valid DB commits
RECRUITER REVIEW PIPELINE STAGES & STATUS CODES
• Optional Technical Tasks: Applications can enter TASK_PENDING and TASK_SUBMITTED phases.
• Rejection Pathway: Recruiter can transition to REJECTED at any phase with structured feedback notes.
• Candidate Withdrawal: Candidate can WITHDRAW their own application; withdrawn apps cannot be edited by recruiter.
• Reviewed Timestamp: reviewedAt field updated on every transition for recruiter SLA reporting.
Prisma Models: JobApplication · Resume · User · Job · EmailDelivery · AuditLog
✓ Immutable Resume Snapshot Guaranteed · Zero Orphaned Disk Files · Non-Blocking Email Delivery
